description: Defines the MediaCommands class for handling media-related command parameters, including setting and retrieving command values.

classes.name: MediaCommands
classes.description: A class encapsulating media command parameters such as width, height, resize mode, format, background color, and quality, with methods to set and retrieve these commands.

methods.name: SetCommands
methods.description: Sets media command properties based on a collection of key-value pairs.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves the set command properties as key-value pairs, excluding unset or whitespace-only properties.
